name: Shaking glow word
what: One glowing word grows out of the dark, pops bigger, then shakes harder and harder - tilting, blurring and dimming - and strobes until a burst of colour swaps it for a second word in a warm orange glow, which rocks gently and burns out.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f26 only the ground; f27-f56 the first word fades up and grows from a speck to full size with its glow; f60-f77 a second pop to 1.43x with a bigger bloom, hold, f88-f98 snaps back; f97-f172 it shakes with growing jumps, a tilt to ~20 deg, a growing blur, dimming; f173-f192 a strobe (dark every 4th frame); f193-f205 the colour shift: the second word lands blurred and orange, sharpens and turns yellow; it rocks to f280, then burns out f281-f295

tracks.name: grow in
tracks.what: the first word fades up and grows from a speck to full size; the glow builds

tracks.name: pop
tracks.what: the word pops to 1.43x with a stronger bloom

tracks.name: snap back
tracks.what: it falls back to full size

tracks.name: shake
tracks.what: jumps that grow, a tilt to ~20 deg, a growing blur, dimming colour and glow

tracks.name: strobe
tracks.what: faint, blurred, jumping; dark every 4th frame; a ghost of the last frame

tracks.name: colour shift
tracks.what: the second word lands smeared by a heavy blur, orange turning yellow, growing to full size

tracks.name: rock
tracks.what: the second word rocks slowly (about +-7 deg) in its orange glow

tracks.name: burn out
tracks.what: the second word and its glow fade out
